messages:
Ethan Brooks: Anyone up for a pickup soccer game Friday? 5:30pm on the courtyard lawn? :soccer:
Priya Kapoor: Count me in! Also thinking of starting a March bracket challenge — winner gets bragging rights and a taco voucher.
Aisha Patel: I can do Friday. March bracket? I'm terrible but will join for snacks.
Miguel Santos: I’ll run the bracket google sheet. Who's in? @Priya Kapoor details?
Ethan Brooks: Sweet. Miguel, can you DM the sheet link? Also does anyone have cones or orange vests?
Priya Kapoor: I'll post the bracket sign-up form now. Prize: one taco voucher + a 15-min trophy ceremony.
Aisha Patel: lol trophy ceremony pls make it short.
Miguel Santos: Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/s/placeholder — fill name + dept. I'll seed teams randomly for soccer too.
Ethan Brooks: Perfect. If rain, fallback to 6pm indoor court at the community center (anyone have key?).
Priya Kapoor: I do not. @Facilities please advise? :pray: 
Aisha Patel: Also quick poll - do we want to cap players at 12 or 16?
Miguel Santos: Let's cap at 14. That way we can do 7v7 rotation.
Ethan Brooks: Agree. I'll bring first-aid kit.
